findings.finding: Expert performers break down required skills into smaller parts and focus on improving those skill chunks during practice.
findings.quote: An expert breaks down the skills that are required to be expert and focuses on improving those skill chunks during practice

findings.finding: Deliberate practice requires immediate feedback so learners can make necessary changes to improve performance.
findings.quote: The student should be able to access immediate feedback about their performance, so they can make the changes needed to improve.

findings.finding: Active engagement in deliberate practice involves opportunities for repeated performance to refine behavior.
findings.quote: opportunities for repeated performance to refine behavior

principle: Expertise is acquired through deliberate practice, which involves breaking down skills into specific chunks, engaging in sustained repetition, and receiving immediate feedback.
for_the_teacher: Break down movements into small skill chunks for focused practice.
Provide immediate feedback during practice sessions so learners can adjust their performance.
